description: Fork of exp196 (soft V2D + untied head, val_bpb≈1.97 @ 4.6K when stopped). Restructure block to standard-transformer style: two residual sub-layers (attn + ffn). Attn sub-layer = LN -> V2D -> per-head Q/K/V -> SDPA -> 2-layer MLP out_proj (E->4E->E). FFN sub-layer = LN -> 2-layer MLP (E->4E->E). Both MLPs use multiplier=4, fc2 zero-init. Soft V2D, untied head, qkv_std=0.005 unchanged.
